import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from safetensors.numpy import load_file
from makemarket.provenance import receipt

pid = int(Path('runs/qwen35_cache_probe.pid').read_text())
while True:
    try:
        os.kill(pid, 0)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        break
    time.sleep(5)
training = json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen35_cache_smoke.json').read_text())
guard = json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen35_cache_memory_guard.json').read_text())
assert training['status'] == guard['status'] == 'completed'
assert training['optimizer_updates'] == 4
initial = 'train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft-interrupted/best.safetensors'
updated = 'train/runs/qwen35-cache-smoke/adapters.safetensors'
a, b = load_file(initial), load_file(updated)
assert a.keys() == b.keys()
deltas = [float(np.abs(a[k].astype(np.float32)-b[k].astype(np.float32)).max()) for k in a]
assert any(d > 0 for d in deltas)
r = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose':'verify four probe updates before full restart'},training['model_revision']),
     'tensors_checked':len(deltas),'tensors_changed':sum(d>0 for d in deltas),
     'maximum_absolute_parameter_delta':max(deltas),
     'initial_adapter_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(initial).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
     'updated_adapter_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(updated).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
     'calculation_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('results/training/qwen35_cache_probe_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
del a, b, deltas
model = str(Path.home()/'.cache/mmb_models/Qwen3.5-4B-MLX-4bit')
revision = '32f3e8ecf65426fc3306969496342d504bfa13f3'
command = ['bash','scripts/with_resource.sh','heavy-ml','.venv/bin/python','-u','train/with_memory_guard.py',
           '--result','results/training/qwen35_sft_memory.json','.venv/bin/python','-u','train/mlx_train.py',
           '--model',model,'--revision',revision,'--resume',initial,'--out','train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft',
           '--result','results/training/qwen35_sft.json','--answer-head-tokens','128']
subprocess.run(command,check=True)
shutil.copyfile('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft/best.safetensors','train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft/adapters.safetensors')
subprocess.run(['bash','scripts/with_resource.sh','heavy-ml','.venv/bin/python','-u','train/mlx_evaluate.py',
                '--model',model,'--revision',revision,'--adapter','train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-sft',
                '--label','qwen3.5-4b-sft','--seed','80000','--episodes','100','--out','results/validation/qwen35-sft'],check=True)
